title: Fourier weight bound at successive odd dimensions
statement: Let $m$ and $k$ be nonnegative integers with $k<2m+3$. The level-$k$ Fourier weight of majority on the Boolean cube of dimension $2m+3$ is at most its level-$k$ Fourier weight on the Boolean cube of dimension $2m+1$.
